_meta: Source of truth for which ai/hooks/*.sh are registered in ~/.claude/settings.json, and on which event/matcher. `ai/bin/check-hooks-registered` asserts these are live (drift is the bug that silently disabled safe-wait-guard + pronoun-guard on 2026-09-17); `scripts/setup-hooks --install` writes them by MERGING (hooks only; the `env` section below is merged only by `--install-env`) (never clobbering the existing block — the clobber is what caused the outage). Paths are repo-relative and expanded to absolute against this repo's location. Matchers are Claude Code tool-name regexes; "" matches all (used for non-tool events). `retired` (DND-1517) is how a hook leaves the machine: each row names the exact {event, matcher, script} wiring that `setup-hooks --install`, run from the MAIN checkout after the retirement lands, unwires (nothing else is touched); `check-hooks-registered` fails while a LANDED retired row is still wired. A retired row is never also a `hooks` row. Keep a retired script on disk (a no-op is fine) until no machine wires it, then delete the script and its row.

env._meta: DND-775. Environment the Claude Code settings `env` carries for agent sessions. `scripts/setup-hooks --install-env` merges it: the OWNER's activation step, never plain `--install`, which is the routine hook-drift fix agents run (git_config pairs APPENDED after any GIT_CONFIG_* the settings already hold, never overwriting them); `scripts/setup-hooks --remove-env` removes exactly these keys (the one-command disable). `ai/bin/check-hooks-registered` reports its state; the states and exits are defined in ai/lib/agent_stash_env.rb. `--install-env` also writes ATHENA_AGENT_ENV_INSTALLED_AT when it adds ATHENA_AGENT_BIN or CLAUDE_ENV_FILE (DND-1036, DND-1080). {{MAIN}} expands to the MAIN checkout's absolute path, never a worktree's. git_config: the reference-transaction hook ai/git-hooks/agent-stash-guard.sh as a config-based hook; its command is an inline sh snippet that fails closed with a Fix: when the script is missing. vars: GIT_TRACE2=/dev/null makes git hand the hook GIT_TRACE2_PARENT_NAME (rule R2); ATHENA_AGENT_BIN names the PATH git wrapper's directory; CLAUDE_ENV_FILE names ai/agent-env/session-env.sh, which Claude Code runs before every Bash tool command, after the shell snapshot, and which prepends ATHENA_AGENT_BIN to PATH (DND-1080: the snapshot ends with Claude Code's own process PATH, so a ~/.zshrc PATH change never reaches the tool shell). --remove-env removes CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, like GIT_TRACE2, only while it holds this value.

git_config.value: h='{{MAIN}}/ai/git-hooks/agent-stash-guard.sh'; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "agent-stash-guard: hook script missing or not executable: $h. Every ref update in this agent session is refused until it is back (fail closed). Fix: restore it with git -C '{{MAIN}}' checkout -- ai/git-hooks/agent-stash-guard.sh; if it cannot be restored, the owner disables the guard with {{MAIN}}/scripts/setup-hooks --remove-env, then restarts sessions." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$h" "$@"
